tournament.name: Metrópolis Series - EMEA Destination Qualifier - Amberes

decks.notes: This Mardu Aggro deck focuses on aggressive creature plays combined with removal and burn spells to control the board and push damage through. Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Ocelot Pride provide powerful threats, while Thoughtseize and Vindicate help disrupt the opponent's game plan. Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer allows for early aggression and card advantage, and Goblin Bombardment provides additional reach. The mana base is carefully constructed to support the deck's aggressive game plan, with a mix of fetch lands and shock lands to ensure consistency and flexibility in casting spells.

This deck focuses on utilizing ramp spells to quickly accelerate mana production, allowing for the early deployment of powerful Eldrazi creatures. By disrupting the opponent's game plan with a mix of removal and disruption spells, the deck aims to control the pace of the game until it can unleash massive threats like Emrakul, the Promised End and World Breaker. The combination of high-impact Eldrazi creatures and versatile control elements creates a formidable strategy that can overwhelm opponents in the late game.

The deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly to cast powerful Titans like Primeval Titan, using cards like Arboreal Grazer and Explore. The key strategy is to utilize Amulet of Vigor to untap lands and generate extra mana, enabling explosive plays like comboing Scapeshift with Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle to deal massive damage. Urza's Saga provides additional utility and tutoring options, while lands like Gruul Turf and Simic Growth Chamber help generate even more mana. The deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with its high-powered threats.

The main focus of this deck is to ramp up mana quickly using cards like Utopia Sprawl and Eldrazi Temple to cast powerful Eldrazi creatures such as Emrakul, the Promised End and World Breaker. The deck also utilizes control elements like Kozilek's Command and Malevolent Rumble to disrupt the opponent's strategy. Additionally, the deck includes card draw options like Nulldrifter and Stock Up to maintain resources. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with big threats while maintaining control of the game through various disruption tactics.

The main focus of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and powerful spells. The deck aims to establish board presence early with efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Territorial Kavu, while also utilizing high-impact cards like Scion of Draco and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury. With a mix of removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Tribal Flames, as well as control options like Consign to Memory and Leyline Binding, the deck seeks to maintain pressure and disrupt the opponent's game plan. Additionally, the mana base is designed to support the deck's color requirements and ensure consistent performance.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures like Ajani, Guide of Souls, and Ragavan while supporting them with spells like Galvanic Discharge and Thraben Charm. The goal is to maintain pressure and control the board with cards like Static Prison and Goblin Bombardment, setting up for a fast victory. The deck also includes disruption with cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and efficient land fetching with cards like Arid Mesa and Marsh Flats. The key concept is to push for a quick win through aggressive plays and strategic disruption.

This deck aims to quickly assemble multiple creatures with +1/+1 counters, making them difficult to deal with while also generating value through sacrificing them. The key concept revolves around efficiently utilizing cards like Basking Broodscale and Glaring Fleshraker in combination with Blade of the Bloodchief to create a powerful board state. The inclusion of removal spells like Kozilek's Command and Malevolent Rumble helps to control the opponent's board while also advancing the deck's game plan. Overall, the deck focuses on overwhelming the opponent with a synergistic combination of creatures and support cards.

This deck focuses on aggressive creatures that can repeatedly enter and leave the battlefield, gaining value through blinking effects. By utilizing cards like Flickerwisp and Ephemerate, you can disrupt your opponent's board while generating advantage for yourself. The deck also includes a mix of removal spells and disruption to control the game tempo. With a combination of powerful creatures and synergistic spells, this Aggro-Blink deck aims to overwhelm your opponent with constant pressure and tricky plays.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on quickly and aggressively putting pressure on the opponent with efficient and powerful creatures like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Goblin Bombardment and Static Prison to control the board and prevent the opponent from stabilizing. The deck aims to close out games quickly with a combination of creature beatdown and burn spells, using cards like Ocelot Pride and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury to overwhelm the opponent before they can establish their own game plan.

This deck focuses on aggressive strategies while utilizing blink effects to gain additional value from creatures entering and leaving the battlefield. By combining powerful creatures with blink cards like Ephemerate and Flickerwisp, the deck can repeatedly trigger enter the battlefield effects and disrupt opponents' plans. With a mix of removal, disruption, and powerful threats, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents quickly and efficiently.

This deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan through a combination of countering spells, hand disruption, and removal. It also aims to control the board with powerful creatures like Murktide Regent and Kaito, Bane of Nightmares. The deck includes a mix of control spells, creatures, and lands that allow for flexibility in handling different types of threats while maintaining card advantage. The goal is to outlast the opponent's resources and win through incremental advantage.

The deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's strategy while controlling the game tempo. It includes a variety of counterspells, hand disruption spells, and removal to handle threats. The creatures included are either resilient or have disruptive abilities to further control the board. The deck aims to maintain card advantage and efficiency in order to outvalue the opponent in the long game. It relies on efficient removal and counterspells to deal with threats while building up its own board presence. It aims to stall the game until it can overwhelm the opponent with its powerful creatures and spells.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through a combination of Eldrazi creatures and ramp spells. By using cards like Sowing Mycospawn and Nulldrifter to generate advantage, while also ramping into big threats like Emrakul, the Promised End and World Breaker, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures. Kozilek's Command and Kozilek's Return provide removal and disruption, while cards like Utopia Sprawl and Eldrazi Temple help accelerate the deck's mana production. The deck seeks to establish board dominance and close out the game with its high-impact threats.

This deck aims to control the game through ramping into powerful Eldrazi creatures while disrupting the opponent's strategy. By using cards like Sowing Mycospawn and Writhing Chrysalis to generate Eldrazi spawn tokens, the deck can quickly ramp into big threats like Emrakul, the Promised End and Ugin, the Eye of the Storms. Kozilek's Command and Kozilek's Return provide removal options, while Utopia Sprawl and ramp spells help accelerate the mana base. The combination of control elements and Eldrazi threats make this deck a formidable force in Modern 1 vs 1.

The deck focuses on using a combination of mana ramp spells and card draw to generate a large amount of mana quickly and cast powerful spells. The key goal is to generate a storm count high enough to win the game with a lethal Grapeshot. The deck includes various ways to dig through the deck to find the needed combo pieces and has some flexibility with wish spells to retrieve key cards from the sideboard. The deck also includes some interaction and protection spells to help survive until the combo can be assembled.

This UW Control deck focuses on countering opponents' spells and controlling the board while using powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and Teferi, Time Raveler to gain card advantage and disrupt opponents' strategies. The deck also utilizes cards like Narset, Parter of Veils to limit opponents' card draw and Solitude for removal. Isochron Scepter provides additional spell versatility, and the land base includes fetch lands for mana fixing. The overall strategy is to outlast opponents and grind out incremental advantages to win the game.
